column1: # Example curation TSV for Update_Enzymes_in_PlantSEED.py
# Demonstrates every action and dummy-populates every schema field that
# this script can write. Lines starting with '#' are ignored. Columns
# MUST be separated by TAB characters, not spaces.
# Action reference (columns 2+):
#   NEW       (no extra cols)                         create an empty role with schema defaults
#   UPDATE    new_name                                rename the role (recomputes kbase_id)
#   ADD       field  entry  [extra]                   append entry to a list/dict field
#   REMOVE    field  entry                            drop entry from a list/dict field
#   RELOCATE  field  old_key  new_key                 rekey a dict entry
#   CHANGE    field  value                            set a scalar field
#   ASSIGN    field  value                            set a scalar field (string-valued)
# ---- 1. Create the role. NEW seeds all required schema fields with their defaults
# ----    and derives abstract_enzyme from the part of the name before " (EC".
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# ---- 2. Populate `subsystems`. The 5th column is the parent CLASS name; the
# ----    script cascades both into the `classes` field as classes{class}{subsystem}=[].
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# ---- 3. Populate `features`. The 5th column is "compartment:source-code" and
# ----    cascades into `localization` as localization{compartment}{feature}=[code].
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# ---- 4. Populate `reactions`. The 5th column is a compartment id and cascades
# ----    into `localization` as localization{compartment}{reaction}=["Assumed"].
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# ---- 5. Optional list-fields with no cascade.
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# ---- 6. Scalar fields. ASSIGN/CHANGE always store the value as a string, so
# ----    fields that need bool/int values (include, is_transporter, homomers)
# ----    are best left at their schema defaults (true, false, 1) seeded by NEW.
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
Example dummy enzyme (EC 9.9.9.99)
# Fields filled automatically (no row needed):
#   role               <- column 1 of the NEW row
#   abstract_enzyme    <- derived from the role name by NEW (overridden by row above)
#   classes            <- cascaded from subsystems ADD (row 2)
#   localization       <- cascaded from features + reactions ADDs (rows 3-4)
#   curators           <- inferred from the path: Curators/<github-username>/...
#   kbase_id           <- hashed from role + reactions[0] + subsystems[0]
#   include, is_transporter, homomers  <- schema defaults seeded by NEW
